name: Gyltige - Simlångsdalen
routeType: point-to-point branch segment; Södra delleden section 4 from the Gyltige junction to the Simlångsdalen branch hub

officialSources.title: Hallandsleden section page
officialSources.note: Primary current page. Reports Gyltige - Simlångsdalen, 7.9 km, green/easy difficulty. Describes crossing Fylleån, following the old Bolmenbanan railway embankment through the Gyltigesjön/Töddesjön/Simlången/Brearedssjön lake valley, passing Hule, crossing road/highway 25 with explicit caution and finishing at the Simlångsdalen bus stop.

lanes.summary: Confirmed canonical identity/order/distance/difficulty, official GPX/API endpoints and metadata, route description, topology, Gyltige/Hule/Simlångsdalen official facilities and key contradictions.
Confirmed official GPX/API geo_json as A-grade 78-point 8.107 km geometry, Naturkartan endpoint-aligned but simplified, OSM relation validation-only and Hallandsleden line.geometry stale/suppressed.
Identified Gyltige/Hule shelters and endpoint services, Brearedssjön side facilities, Simlångsdalen services, water/toilet conflicts and off-route leakage suppressions.
Confirmed weak public transport at Gyltige, good Gyltige parking/pickup, strong Simlångsdalen bus endpoint access and nearby parking/service access caveats.
Found no active closure/reroute, supported easy flat Bolmenbanan/lake-valley character, and flagged mostly stale/adjacent field evidence plus Hule water uncertainty.
Found highway 25 crossing warning, Fylleån Natura 2000 crossing, Simlångsdalen-Hule water-protection span, Hule reserve rules, dynamic fire/dog/hunting/forestry currentness and no active closure.

researchIterations.mainThreadSynthesis: Evidence is strong enough for research-ready S4 without a targeted follow-up batch. Remaining weaknesses are explicit import caveats: Gyltige water/toilet conflict, Hule toilet distance variation, stale Gyltige-Assman/Naturkartan slug and old source boundaries, weak Gyltige transit, route graph snapping at Gyltige/Simlångsdalen branch hubs, and dynamic fire/forestry/transit checks.

importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Gyltige - Simlångsdalen, Södra delleden, S4 local/inventory label, official order 20, 7.9 km, easy/green, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Gyltige the route crosses Fylleån and follows the old Bolmenbanan railway embankment south through the lake valley of Gyltigesjön, Töddesjön, Simlången and Brearedssjön. It passes Hule nature reserve and campsite before crossing highway 25, where extra care is required, and then follows the embankment toward the bus stop and services in Simlångsdalen.
importReadiness.geometry: ready with caveats: official GPX/API geo_json is canonical 78-point 8.107 km line; Hallandsleden API line.geometry is stale/branch line and must be suppressed; Naturkartan is endpoint-aligned but simplified and has stale slug; OSM is validation-only.
